Detail.damage/zero-head.bytes.description: The sentence under the bytes setting of the zero-head damage, after what it takes.
Detail.damage/zero-head.bytes.other: How many bytes at the start are zeroed. Below four, some formats come out with damage no reader complains about.

Detail.format/avif.height.description: The sentence under the height setting of the avif format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/avif.height.other: How tall the picture is. Left out, a size is chosen that fits the bytes you asked for.

Detail.format/avif.quality.description: The sentence under the quality setting of the avif format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/avif.quality.other: How much detail the picture keeps. Higher looks better and takes more of the file, leaving less room for padding.

Detail.format/avif.width.description: The sentence under the width setting of the avif format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/avif.width.other: How wide the picture is. Left out, a size is chosen that fits the bytes you asked for.

Detail.format/bmp.height.description: The sentence under the height setting of the bmp format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/bmp.height.other: How tall the picture is. Left out, the picture is sized to fill the bytes you asked for.

Detail.format/bmp.width.description: The sentence under the width setting of the bmp format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/bmp.width.other: How wide the picture is. Left out, the picture is sized to fill the bytes you asked for.

Detail.format/csv.columns.description: The sentence under the columns setting of the csv format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/csv.columns.other: How many columns each row has. Above 16384 a spreadsheet may show only the first 16384 and drop the rest without a word.

Detail.format/csv.delimiter.description: The sentence under the delimiter setting of the csv format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/csv.delimiter.other: What separates the fields. Choose semicolon for the shape a European spreadsheet exports.

Detail.format/csv.header.description: The sentence under the header setting of the csv format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/csv.header.other: Whether the first row names the columns. Turn it off for a table dumped straight out of a database.

Detail.format/csv.line_ending.description: The sentence under the line_ending setting of the csv format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/csv.line_ending.other: How each row ends. Choose crlf for the shape RFC 4180 asks for and Excel writes.

Detail.format/csv.quote_style.description: The sentence under the quote_style setting of the csv format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/csv.quote_style.other: Which fields carry quotes. With none the description stops carrying separators as well, because an unquoted field cannot hold one.

Detail.format/docx.paragraphs.description: The sentence under the paragraphs setting of the docx format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/docx.paragraphs.other: How many paragraphs of text the document holds. The rest of the size you asked for is carried by a part of the package that is not shown.

Detail.format/gif.frames.description: The sentence under the frames setting of the gif format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/gif.frames.other: How many frames the animation has. Set it to 1 for a still picture.

Detail.format/gif.height.description: The sentence under the height setting of the gif format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/gif.height.other: How tall the picture is. Left out, a size is chosen that fits the bytes you asked for.

Detail.format/gif.width.description: The sentence under the width setting of the gif format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/gif.width.other: How wide the picture is. Left out, a size is chosen that fits the bytes you asked for.

Detail.format/html.structure.description: The sentence under the structure setting of the html format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/html.structure.other: Whether the file is a whole page or only the blocks that would sit inside one. A fragment has no doctype, no html element and no body, which is what a content field or the body of an email really holds. It is far smaller, so the smallest fragment sits well below the smallest page.

Detail.format/ico.embed.description: The sentence under the embed setting of the ico format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/ico.embed.other: What sits inside the icon. A bitmap is read by every version of Windows. A PNG makes the file much smaller and needs Windows Vista or newer.

Detail.format/ico.height.description: The sentence under the height setting of the ico format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/ico.height.other: How tall the icon is. Left out, the largest standard icon size that fits is used.

Detail.format/ico.width.description: The sentence under the width setting of the ico format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/ico.width.other: How wide the icon is. Left out, the largest standard icon size that fits is used.

Detail.format/jpg.height.description: The sentence under the height setting of the jpg format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/jpg.height.other: How tall the picture is. Left out, a size is chosen that fits the bytes you asked for.

Detail.format/jpg.quality.description: The sentence under the quality setting of the jpg format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/jpg.quality.other: How much detail survives compression, from 1 to 100. JPEG throws detail away by design, so a low number gives a visibly softer picture. It changes how large the picture encodes to, not the size of the file you asked for.

Detail.format/jpg.width.description: The sentence under the width setting of the jpg format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/jpg.width.other: How wide the picture is. Left out, a size is chosen that fits the bytes you asked for.

Detail.format/json.formatting.description: The sentence under the formatting setting of the json format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/json.formatting.other: How the document is laid out. Every reader accepts all three, so this changes what meets everything around the parser rather than the parser itself - minified puts the whole file on one line and ends without a newline, and indented makes the same records several times larger.

Detail.format/jxl.height.description: The sentence under the height setting of the jxl format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/jxl.height.other: How tall the picture is. Left out, a size is chosen that fits the bytes you asked for.

Detail.format/jxl.quality.description: The sentence under the quality setting of the jxl format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/jxl.quality.other: How much detail the picture keeps. Higher looks better and takes more of the file, leaving less room for padding.

Detail.format/jxl.width.description: The sentence under the width setting of the jxl format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/jxl.width.other: How wide the picture is. Left out, a size is chosen that fits the bytes you asked for.

Detail.format/log.entry_format.description: The sentence under the entry_format setting of the log format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/log.entry_format.other: Which kind of log to write. Web server shapes carry a request and a status, the others carry a level and a message.

Detail.format/log.ip_version.description: The sentence under the ip_version setting of the log format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/log.ip_version.other: Which kind of client address appears. Choose v6 to find out whether a reader handles it.

Detail.format/log.level_mix.description: The sentence under the level_mix setting of the log format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/log.level_mix.other: Which severities appear. Only the plain and json-lines shapes carry one, and asking for it beside another shape is refused.

Detail.format/log.line_ending.description: The sentence under the line_ending setting of the log format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/log.line_ending.other: How each line ends. Choose crlf for a log written by a Windows service.

Detail.format/log.methods.description: The sentence under the methods setting of the log format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/log.methods.other: Which request methods appear. Read is GET and HEAD, mixed adds POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE.

Detail.format/log.rate.description: The sentence under the rate setting of the log format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/log.rate.other: How fast the entries arrive. Only means anything while timestamps advance.

Detail.format/log.status_mix.description: The sentence under the status_mix setting of the log format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/log.status_mix.other: Which response codes appear. Realistic is mostly success with a tail of errors.

Detail.format/log.timestamps.description: The sentence under the timestamps setting of the log format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/log.timestamps.other: Whether each entry happens later than the one before it. Fixed puts every entry at the same instant, which is what this format did before it could advance.

Detail.format/md.bom.description: The sentence under the bom setting of the md format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/md.bom.other: Whether the file opens with a byte order mark. A reader that has to guess the encoding needs one, and a reader that does not expect it shows it as stray characters at the start of the file.

Detail.format/md.encoding.description: The sentence under the encoding setting of the md format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/md.encoding.other: Which encoding the characters are written in. UTF-16 stores two bytes per character, so a file in it always has an even number of bytes and an odd size is refused.

Detail.format/pdf.author.description: The sentence under the author setting of the pdf format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/pdf.author.other: The author in the document properties. Left empty, the document names none.

Detail.format/pdf.created.description: The sentence under the created setting of the pdf format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/pdf.created.other: When the document says it was created. A time written without a zone is kept without one, and none leaves the date out.

Detail.format/pdf.creator.description: The sentence under the creator setting of the pdf format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/pdf.creator.other: The program the document says it was written in, such as Microsoft Word. Left empty, the document names none.

Detail.format/pdf.keywords.description: The sentence under the keywords setting of the pdf format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/pdf.keywords.other: The keywords in the document properties, as one line of text. Left empty, the document has none.

Detail.format/pdf.modified.description: The sentence under the modified setting of the pdf format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/pdf.modified.other: When the document says it was last changed, written the same way as created. Left empty, the document has no such date.

Detail.format/pdf.orientation.description: The sentence under the orientation setting of the pdf format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/pdf.orientation.other: Whether pages stand upright or lie wide. Mixed alternates the two, starting upright, and needs at least two pages.

Detail.format/pdf.page_size.description: The sentence under the page_size setting of the pdf format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/pdf.page_size.other: The paper size every page uses. Mixed goes through a4, letter, legal, a3 and a5 in turn, one a page, and needs at least two pages.

Detail.format/pdf.pages.description: The sentence under the pages setting of the pdf format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/pdf.pages.other: How many pages the document has.

Detail.format/pdf.pdf_version.description: The sentence under the pdf_version setting of the pdf format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/pdf.pdf_version.other: The version written at the start of the file. Nothing else changes, because the document uses nothing newer than 1.4.

Detail.format/pdf.producer.description: The sentence under the producer setting of the pdf format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/pdf.producer.other: The program the document says turned it into a PDF.

Detail.format/pdf.rotate.description: The sentence under the rotate setting of the pdf format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/pdf.rotate.other: Asks the reader to turn every page clockwise by this many degrees when it shows it. The page itself stays upright, so a reader that ignores the request shows it unturned.

Detail.format/pdf.subject.description: The sentence under the subject setting of the pdf format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/pdf.subject.other: The subject in the document properties. Left empty, the document has none.

Detail.format/pdf.title.description: The sentence under the title setting of the pdf format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/pdf.title.other: The title a reader shows in its title bar and in the document properties. Left empty, the title is the self describing label, or the name of this tool without one.

Detail.format/png.height.description: The sentence under the height setting of the png format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/png.height.other: How tall the picture is. Left out, a size is chosen that fits the bytes you asked for.

Detail.format/png.width.description: The sentence under the width setting of the png format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/png.width.other: How wide the picture is. Left out, a size is chosen that fits the bytes you asked for.

Detail.format/pptx.slides.description: The sentence under the slides setting of the pptx format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/pptx.slides.other: How many slides the presentation holds. The rest of the size you asked for is carried by a part of the package that is not shown.

Detail.format/svg.height.description: The sentence under the height setting of the svg format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/svg.height.other: How tall the drawing says it is. The label sits along the bottom edge, so a drawing shorter than that strip carries no visible label.

Detail.format/svg.width.description: The sentence under the width setting of the svg format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/svg.width.other: How wide the drawing says it is. Nothing is drawn into pixels here, so a large number costs a few bytes in the file and a great deal of memory in whatever opens it.

Detail.format/targz.compression.description: The sentence under the compression setting of the targz format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/targz.compression.other: How hard the files inside are squeezed. The archive still comes out the size you asked for - what changes is how much of it is real content and how much is padding.

Detail.format/targz.depth.description: The sentence under the depth setting of the targz format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/targz.depth.other: How many directories deep the files inside sit. 0 puts them all at the top.

Detail.format/targz.directory_entries.description: The sentence under the directory_entries setting of the targz format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/targz.directory_entries.other: Whether the archive also lists the directories themselves. Most file browsers show the same folders either way, so the difference is in the entry list rather than on screen. It matters for readers that only create a directory the archive names.

Detail.format/targz.entries.description: The sentence under the entries setting of the targz format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/targz.entries.other: How many files the archive holds. Use contains instead when the files are not all alike.

Detail.format/targz.entry_format.description: The sentence under the entry_format setting of the targz format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/targz.entry_format.other: The format of the files inside. Run tfg formats to see what this build supports.

Detail.format/targz.entry_mode.description: The sentence under the entry_mode setting of the targz format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/targz.entry_mode.other: The permissions recorded for each file inside. It is what the archive says, not what the file gets - that depends on who unpacks it and how.

Detail.format/targz.entry_owner.description: The sentence under the entry_owner setting of the targz format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/targz.entry_owner.other: Who each file inside belongs to. Leave it unset and the archive names nobody, which is what most archives written by a build carry.

Detail.format/targz.entry_size.description: The sentence under the entry_size setting of the targz format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/targz.entry_size.other: How big each file inside is.

Detail.format/tiff.height.description: The sentence under the height setting of the tiff format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/tiff.height.other: How tall the picture is. Left out, the picture is sized to fill the bytes you asked for.

Detail.format/tiff.width.description: The sentence under the width setting of the tiff format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/tiff.width.other: How wide the picture is. Left out, the picture is sized to fill the bytes you asked for.

Detail.format/txt.bom.description: The sentence under the bom setting of the txt format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/txt.bom.other: Whether the file opens with a byte order mark. A reader that has to guess the encoding needs one, and a reader that does not expect it shows it as stray characters at the start of the file.

Detail.format/txt.encoding.description: The sentence under the encoding setting of the txt format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/txt.encoding.other: Which encoding the characters are written in. UTF-16 stores two bytes per character, so a file in it always has an even number of bytes and an odd size is refused.

Detail.format/wav.bit_depth.description: The sentence under the bit_depth setting of the wav format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/wav.bit_depth.other: How many bits each sample uses.

Detail.format/wav.channels.description: The sentence under the channels setting of the wav format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/wav.channels.other: How many channels the signal has, so 1 for mono and 2 for stereo.

Detail.format/wav.content.description: The sentence under the content setting of the wav format, after what it takes.

Detail.format/wav.sample_rate.description: The sentence under the sample_rate setting of the wav format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/wav.sample_rate.other: How many samples a second the signal carries.

Detail.format/webm.change_interval.description: The sentence under the change_interval setting of the webm format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/webm.change_interval.other: How often the picture changes: the clock in it moves on and the square takes a step. Each change costs a whole picture in bytes and in time. An interval as long as the film or longer keeps one picture throughout.

Detail.format/webm.duration.description: The sentence under the duration setting of the webm format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/webm.duration.other: How long the film plays. It has to end on a frame, so at 30 frames a second it goes in steps of 100ms.

Detail.format/webm.frame_rate.description: The sentence under the frame_rate setting of the webm format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/webm.frame_rate.other: How many frames the film shows each second.

Detail.format/webm.height.description: The sentence under the height setting of the webm format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/webm.height.other: How tall the picture is. Left out, a size is chosen that fits the bytes you asked for.

Detail.format/webm.keyframe_interval.description: The sentence under the keyframe_interval setting of the webm format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/webm.keyframe_interval.other: How far apart the frames are that a player can start from. Shorter makes skipping through a long film faster and the file bigger, because each of them carries the whole picture twice.

Detail.format/webm.quality.description: The sentence under the quality setting of the webm format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/webm.quality.other: How much detail the picture keeps. Higher looks better and takes more of the file, leaving less room for padding.

Detail.format/webm.width.description: The sentence under the width setting of the webm format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/webm.width.other: How wide the picture is. Left out, a size is chosen that fits the bytes you asked for.

Detail.format/webp.height.description: The sentence under the height setting of the webp format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/webp.height.other: How tall the picture is. Left out, the picture is sized to fill the bytes you asked for.

Detail.format/webp.width.description: The sentence under the width setting of the webp format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/webp.width.other: How wide the picture is. Left out, the picture is sized to fill the bytes you asked for.

Detail.format/xlsx.columns.description: The sentence under the columns setting of the xlsx format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/xlsx.columns.other: How many columns each row has. Above 16384 a spreadsheet may show only the first 16384 and drop the rest without a word.

Detail.format/xlsx.rows.description: The sentence under the rows setting of the xlsx format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/xlsx.rows.other: How many rows of cells the sheet holds. The rest of the size you asked for is carried by a part of the package that is not shown.

Detail.format/xml.bom.description: The sentence under the bom setting of the xml format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/xml.bom.other: Whether the file opens with a byte order mark. A reader that has to guess the encoding needs one, and a reader that does not expect it shows it as stray characters at the start of the file.

Detail.format/xml.encoding.description: The sentence under the encoding setting of the xml format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/xml.encoding.other: Which encoding the characters are written in. UTF-16 stores two bytes per character, so a file in it always has an even number of bytes and an odd size is refused.

Detail.format/zip.compression.description: The sentence under the compression setting of the zip format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/zip.compression.other: How hard the files inside are squeezed. The archive still comes out the size you asked for - what changes is how much of it is real content and how much is padding.

Detail.format/zip.depth.description: The sentence under the depth setting of the zip format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/zip.depth.other: How many directories deep the files inside sit. 0 puts them all at the top.

Detail.format/zip.directory_entries.description: The sentence under the directory_entries setting of the zip format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/zip.directory_entries.other: Whether the archive also lists the directories themselves. Most file browsers show the same folders either way, so the difference is in the entry list rather than on screen. It matters for readers that only create a directory the archive names.

Detail.format/zip.encryption.description: The sentence under the encryption setting of the zip format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/zip.encryption.other: How the archive is locked. AES is the WinZip scheme, and some readers cannot open it at all. ZipCrypto is the old one every reader opens and nothing modern trusts, and some of them hand back the encrypted bytes without saying so. A locked archive from this tool is a fixture rather than protection - the key is worked out from the run seed, so the same recipe gives the same archive on any machine, and the password is written into the manifest beside it.

Detail.format/zip.entries.description: The sentence under the entries setting of the zip format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/zip.entries.other: How many files the archive holds. Use contains instead when the files are not all alike.

Detail.format/zip.entry_format.description: The sentence under the entry_format setting of the zip format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/zip.entry_format.other: The format of the files inside. Run tfg formats to see what this build supports.

Detail.format/zip.entry_size.description: The sentence under the entry_size setting of the zip format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/zip.entry_size.other: How big each file inside is.

Detail.format/zip.password.description: The sentence under the password setting of the zip format, after what it takes.
Detail.format/zip.password.other: The password the archive is locked with. It is written into the manifest as you typed it, because a test that cannot open the file cannot check anything.

Detail.preset/empty-and-minimal.formats.other: Which formats the set is built from. Leave it at all for every format this build has, or name the ones your system accepts.

Detail.preset/filename-handling.format.other: What kind of file the whole set is made of.

Detail.preset/size-boundaries.format.description: The sentence under the format setting of the size-boundaries preset, after what it takes.
Detail.preset/size-boundaries.format.other: What kind of file the whole set is made of.

Detail.preset/size-boundaries.limit.description: The sentence under the limit setting of the size-boundaries preset, after what it takes.
Detail.preset/size-boundaries.limit.other: The size limit your system declares. Everything else is measured from it.

Detail.preset/size-boundaries.spread.description: The sentence under the spread setting of the size-boundaries preset, after what it takes.
Detail.preset/size-boundaries.spread.other: How far either side of the limit to reach, as a list of sizes.

Detail.preset/tabular-import.columns.description: The sentence under the columns setting of the tabular-import preset, after what it takes.
Detail.preset/tabular-import.columns.other: How many columns each row of the spreadsheet has. Rows times columns has a ceiling, and asking past it is refused before anything is written.

Detail.preset/tabular-import.rows.description: The sentence under the rows setting of the tabular-import preset, after what it takes.
Detail.preset/tabular-import.rows.other: How many rows the spreadsheet holds. It is written at exactly the size that many rows package to, so the budget above moves with this.

Detail.preset/text-encoding.sample.description: The sentence under the sample setting of the text-encoding preset, after what it takes.
Detail.preset/text-encoding.sample.other: How big each file of the set is. UTF-16 stores two bytes for every character, so an odd number is refused.

Detail.preset/upload-validation.allow.description: The sentence under the allow setting of the upload-validation preset, after what it takes.
Detail.preset/upload-validation.allow.other: Which types your form is supposed to accept. Each one becomes a real file of that type, and they are the positive control of the whole set.

Detail.preset/upload-validation.bulk.description: The sentence under the bulk setting of the upload-validation preset, after what it takes.
Detail.preset/upload-validation.bulk.other: How many files the mass upload holds. Nought leaves that group out of the set altogether.

Detail.preset/upload-validation.deny.description: The sentence under the deny setting of the upload-validation preset, after what it takes.
Detail.preset/upload-validation.deny.other: Which extensions your form is supposed to turn away. An extension this build has no format for still gets a file under that name, holding plain text.

Detail.preset/upload-validation.far-over.description: The sentence under the far-over setting of the upload-validation preset, after what it takes.
Detail.preset/upload-validation.far-over.other: How far past the limit the one big file goes. Turn it off where writing several times the limit is not worth the disk.

Detail.preset/upload-validation.limit.description: The sentence under the limit setting of the upload-validation preset, after what it takes.
Detail.preset/upload-validation.limit.other: The size limit your upload form declares. This set takes one step either side of it - for a file at every distance, run the size-boundaries preset.

Detail.tool/checksum-write.algorithm.description: The sentence under the algorithm setting of the checksum-write tool, after what it takes.
Detail.tool/checksum-write.algorithm.other: Which checksum to write. sha256 is the one sha256sum and most release pages use.

Detail.tool/checksum.algorithm.description: The sentence under the algorithm setting of the checksum tool, after what it takes.
Detail.tool/checksum.algorithm.other: Which checksums to work out: md5, sha1, sha256, sha512 or crc32. Only sha256 and sha512 still show that nobody changed the file on purpose. crc32 is the one ZIP and PNG use, not the one cksum prints.

Detail.tool/checksum.expected.description: The sentence under the expected setting of the checksum tool, after what it takes.
Detail.tool/checksum.expected.other: The checksum the file should have. The algorithm is told from its length, and worked out even when it is not chosen above.

Tool.checksum-check.Note.changed.other: Changed while it was being read, so no checksum is given:

Tool.checksum-check.Note.checked.description: A line of the result of the checksum-check tool, ending in a colon - what follows it is a list of names or one number.

Tool.checksum-check.Note.itself.description: A line of the result of the checksum-check tool, ending in a colon - what follows it is a list of names or one number.
Tool.checksum-check.Note.itself.other: The checksum file itself, which cannot hold its own checksum - not checked:

Tool.checksum-check.Note.mismatched.description: A line of the result of the checksum-check tool, ending in a colon - what follows it is a list of names or one number.
Tool.checksum-check.Note.mismatched.other: Not what the checksum file says:

Tool.checksum-check.Note.missing.description: A line of the result of the checksum-check tool, ending in a colon - what follows it is a list of names or one number.

Tool.checksum-check.Note.not_a_file.description: A line of the result of the checksum-check tool, ending in a colon - what follows it is a list of names or one number.
Tool.checksum-check.Note.not_a_file.other: Listed and not a file - a folder, a pipe, a device or a socket - so not read:

Tool.checksum-check.Note.not_checksums.description: A line of the result of the checksum-check tool, ending in a colon - what follows it is a list of names or one number.
Tool.checksum-check.Note.not_checksums.other: Lines that are not checksums, not checked:

Tool.checksum-check.Note.outside.description: A line of the result of the checksum-check tool, ending in a colon - what follows it is a list of names or one number.
Tool.checksum-check.Note.outside.other: Listed with a path that leaves the folder of the checksum file, so not read:

Tool.checksum-check.Note.twice.description: A line of the result of the checksum-check tool, ending in a colon - what follows it is a list of names or one number.
Tool.checksum-check.Note.twice.other: Listed more than once - every line was checked:

Tool.checksum-check.Note.unknown.description: A line of the result of the checksum-check tool, ending in a colon - what follows it is a list of names or one number.
Tool.checksum-check.Note.unknown.other: Lines of an algorithm this tool does not work out, not checked:

Tool.checksum-check.Note.unreadable.description: A line of the result of the checksum-check tool, ending in a colon - what follows it is a list of names or one number.
Tool.checksum-check.Note.unreadable.other: Listed and could not be read:

Tool.checksum-check.Question.description: The question the checksum-check tool answers - its name in the list of tools and the title over it.
Tool.checksum-check.Question.other: Is every file still what its checksum file says?

Tool.checksum-write.Detail.description: One sentence under the question of the checksum-write tool, saying what it does.
Tool.checksum-write.Detail.other: Writes the checksum of every file in a folder into one file beside them, SHA256SUMS for sha256. Check it later with tfg tool checksum-check, or with sha256sum -c in that folder.

Tool.checksum-write.Note.links.description: A line of the result of the checksum-write tool, ending in a colon - what follows it is a list of names or one number.
Tool.checksum-write.Note.links.other: Left out, because they are links and a link is not followed:

Tool.checksum-write.Note.listed.description: A line of the result of the checksum-write tool, ending in a colon - what follows it is a list of names or one number.

Tool.checksum-write.Note.others.description: A line of the result of the checksum-write tool, ending in a colon - what follows it is a list of names or one number.
Tool.checksum-write.Note.others.other: Left out, because they are not files - a pipe, a device, a socket or a junction - and reading one may never end:
